question: After the merged Web UI session-thread work, should this broad topic/session management issue continue owning the remaining TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export scope, or should maintainers split those slices into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main solves several Web UI and chat-naming pieces, but the remaining behavior crosses product, protocol, CLI/TUI UX, and persisted state boundaries that should not be queued as one automated fix.

options.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad maintainer-scoped tracker while using narrower linked issues for implementation slices where they already exist.

options.title: Split And Close Umbrella
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical issues for TUI, CLI lifecycle, metadata, and import/export, then close this issue once those links preserve the remaining scope.

options.title: Declare Web UI Scope Sufficient
options.body: Treat the current main Web UI/sidebar/picker thread management as enough and close the issue, accepting that TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export remain out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad maintainer-scoped tracker while using narrower linked issues for implementation slices where they already exist.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged session-thread management foundation and are the clearest current owner for deciding whether the remaining broad scope stays here or splits.
